product_overview: NetManager is an integrated ISP management platform designed to streamline network infrastructure operations, financial workflows, human resource management, and customer support. It features seamless integration with MikroTik routers, Radius servers, and various payment gateways to provide an end-to-end solution for ISPs.
core_goals: Provide robust network and bandwidth management supporting MikroTik router integration.
Automate customer billing, invoice generation, and financial tracking with payment gateway integration.
Enable comprehensive HR functionalities including attendance tracking, shift scheduling, overtime, and payroll processing.
Secure system access through role-based access control and authentication.
Manage inventory and procurement workflows effectively to support operational needs.
Enhance customer support with ticketing, notifications, and field work order systems.
key_features: Network & MikroTik Management including bandwidth control, PPP profile handling, and router status monitoring.
Automated billing system with invoice generation and integration with Midtrans and Xendit payment gateways.
Employee attendance management with geofence-based check-in/out, shift and overtime management, and payroll processing.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) securing different user levels and site-specific permissioning.
Inventory management and procurement including asset tracking and supplier management.
Work order and ticketing system for field technicians with integrated notifications.
Real-time monitoring and geographic visualization of network infrastructure using Leaflet/OpenLayers.
Internal announcement system and automated multi-channel notifications via WhatsApp, Email, and Web Push.
user_flow_summary: User authentication via secure login using email and password with RBAC enforcement.
Dashboard presentation tailored to the user's role displaying relevant network, finance, or HR data.
Customer payment processing through payment links integrated with gateways; automatic update of bill payment statuses via callbacks.
Employee attendance capturing via geofence-triggered check-in/out process and shift/overtime tracking.
Network administrators managing bandwidth and PPP profiles directly via integrated MikroTik systems.
Field technicians creating and resolving work orders via ticketing system with status notifications.
Managers viewing financial reports and customer billing analytics on the platform.
validation_criteria: All network management commands reflect correctly on the integrated MikroTik routers and Radius servers.
Invoices are generated and sent automatically on schedule without errors.
Payment statuses reflect accurately and update real-time upon gateway callbacks.
Attendance logs correctly register only within geofenced areas and overtime calculations are accurate.
Role-based access restrictions are enforced and no unauthorized access occurs.
Inventory and procurement records update accurately with full traceability.
Work order tickets follow correct lifecycle states and notifications are delivered on time.
System performance meets real-time response requirements under peak loads.
Automated cron jobs execute critical tasks like billing and backups reliably without failures.
